properties.about: Sectors of the 1971 Liberation War, 1–9 and 11 (sector 10 had no land area). Traced from the sector map in NCTB «বাংলাদেশ ও বিশ্বপরিচয়», অষ্টম শ্রেণি (2026), p. ২৬; outer edge and snapped stretches from OCHA COD-AB v03 (BBS). Approximate: the book draws the sectors on a small map. Built by tools/build-liberation-sectors.mjs from sector-trace.json.
